---
title: Getting Started
order: 0
type: reference
---

## 1. Get the extension into your project

Copy (or `quarto add`, once this is published somewhere `quarto add` can
reach) the `_extensions/quarto-graph/` directory into your Quarto project, so
it sits at `<your-project>/_extensions/quarto-graph/`.

## 2. Wire it into `_quarto.yml`

```yaml
project:
  type: quarto-graph

filters:
  - quarto-graph
```

See [[Under the Hood]] for why it's two separate lines rather than one:
they're two different, non-interchangeable ways an extension can hook into
a project.

## 3. Install the Python package

`quarto render` needs the `quarto-graph` Python package installed in
whatever Python environment it invokes:

```sh
pip install -e ./quarto-graph
```

## 4. Write wikilinks directly in your own pages

There's no separate source directory to write into. Write
double-bracketed wikilinks directly in your project's real `.qmd`/`.md`
pages, wherever they already live:

```markdown
---
title: My Page
type: concept
also-known-as: [alias one, alias two]
---

# My Page

See [[Other Page]] and [[Other Page#Some Heading|a custom link label]].
```

See [[Wikilinks and Aliases]] for the full linking syntax.

## 5. Render

```sh
quarto preview .
```

A wikilink resolves live, at render time, against every other page in the
project. Nothing rewrites your `.qmd` source, ever. Adding a *brand new*
page mid-preview-session needs a restart (stop and re-run `quarto
preview`) before other pages can link to it; editing an *existing* page's
own content re-resolves on its own (see [[Under the Hood]]).

## Frontmatter reference

| Key | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `title:` | Page title, and the link text shown when a wikilink has no `\|display` override |
| `type:` | Colors the node in the graph widget: `concept`, `person`, `reference`, `project`, `experiment`, `moc`; anything else (or omitted) falls back to gray |
| `also-known-as:` | Extra names this page's wikilinks can be reached by, on top of its filename. A separate key from Quarto's own `aliases:`; see [[Wikilinks and Aliases]] for why |
